name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan Horvat's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching rally races in the Croatian countryside. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, Ivan joined a small racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving and his meticulous approach to vehicle setup. He spent several years honing his skills before securing a position at Herberth Motorsport.

As Technical Director, Ivan focuses on optimizing vehicle performance through data analysis and innovative engineering solutions. He demands precision and collaboration from his team, believing that a unified approach is essential to success. His relentless pursuit of improvement and his ability to see the broader implications of technical adjustments make him a valuable asset to the team. He's known for his detailed pre-race briefings and his ability to quickly diagnose issues during a race.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ivan is of average height, with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on having the garage floor perfectly clean before each race.
